176301.description:
Using her wit and vast knowledge of medicines and poisons alike, Maomao played a pivotal role in solving a series of mysteries and conspiracies that plagued the imperial court. Having recently come to terms with the secrets of her parents, she returns to fulfill her normal duties on behalf of the emperor's highest-ranking consorts. Maomao also works alongside the eunuch Jinshi to better the consorts' many ladies-in-waiting, including helping them learn to read.

However, with the arrival of a merchant caravan comes a new wave of intrigue. A pattern of strange coincidences involving the visitors and their wares unsettles Maomao, driving her to investigate the puzzling circumstances behind the convoy. As dangers from both outside and within threaten the balance between the imperial concubines, Maomao continues to utilize her cunning and medical expertise to keep the women safe from harm.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

176910.description:
KILLTUBE is a animated project that exudes the theme "Edopunk". It depicts Tokyo's Shibuya and Shinjuku districts in a parallel world, where the Edo shogunate has closed off Japan and carried on for over four centuries into 2026. In this isolated, stratified society, the only way to change one's standing in life is through participating in live-streamed mortal combat.

The battle entertainment story unfolds when an unlikely trio from the lowest depths of society withstand ridicule and aim for the top. As they win over the general public, they discover the hidden truth behind the KILLTUBE system.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

176660.description:
The second and third cours of Sengoku Youko, adapting the "Thousandfold Chaos" arc.

The chaotic aftermath of a confrontation between Jinka Yamato and Yazen results in the power dynamics between the magically gifted katawara and humans being turned upside down. As the news of the downfall of dangaishu—the katawara-hunting monks led by Yazen—spreads across the country, rogue groups of katawara start to form, worsening the already-fragile relationship between them and humanity.

An alcoholic Shinsuke Hyoudou now finds himself in the company of Senya, a former enemy of his who controls one thousand katawara within his body. Suffering from amnesia and unaware of his past life, Senya soon makes friends with a local village girl, Tsukiko. After a sudden surprise attack from a local god gone mad, this unlikely trio begin a new journey! Meanwhile, Tama Youko continues her search for the nine-tailed fox who now has the power to destroy the world: Jinka.

(Source: MAL Rewrite, edited)

Four episodic shorts will take fans into the flavourful world of WcDonald’s, where a story about the WcDonald’s Sauce and WcNuggets unfolds each week, The shorts will honor four of anime's biggest genres - Action, Romance, Mecha, and Fantasy.

1) The Race to WcDonald’s: WcDonald’s Sauce has arrived, marking the moment everyone has eagerly anticipated. The announcement excites fans across the land, sparking an all-out, action-filled race between two strangers to be the first to experience this long-awaited delicacy. Find out who comes out on top in the race to WcDonald’s.

2) Love from Across the Booth: Our two protagonists discover the WcDonald’s Sauce and WcNuggets aren’t the only perfect pairing. Just one glance… and just one dip… that’s all it takes for love to unfold. Kazuki and Shizuru must face their feelings in the second installment of WcDonald’s!

3) WcNuggets Space Frontier 3000: On the Moon-Base WcDonald's, a space monster suddenly disrupts the balance with a growing hunger for WcNuggets. Assemble! The crew at the Moon-Base WcDonald’s is ready for action boarding the famous mecha WcDizer 3000. But can they keep the sauce safe from the Wakudon’s attack and tip the scales against this Class A monster?

4) The Wisdom of the Sauce: During the final week of WcDonald’s Sauce, three friends meet to savor this occasion one last time, wishing this flavor never had to disappear. And that wish might just be granted as they’re transported to a distant, magical land, where they are challenged to seek the wisdom of the sage Kenja and keep the WcDonald’s Sauce. Will our heroes triumph in their quest?

(Source: WcDonald's, Press Release, edited)
